bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test -d "$repo/.git" || test -f "$repo/.git"
origin="$(git -C "$repo" remote get-url origin)"
case "$origin" in *seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot*) ;; *) exit 73;; esac
active_before="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
enabled_before="$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
image="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || echo absent)"
running="$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || echo false)"
result=BLOCKED
if test "$active_before" = active && test "$running" = true; then
  if (cd "$repo" && timeout 70s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py profile_button_smoke >/dev/null 2>&1); then result=PASS; else result=FAIL; fi
fi
active_after="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
enabled_after="$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
{
  echo "PROFILE_BUTTON_LIVE_CHECK=$result"
  echo "GAYBBS_RUNNING=$running"
  echo "GAYBBS_IMAGE=$image"
  echo "USERBOT_ACTIVE_BEFORE=$active_before"
  echo "USERBOT_ACTIVE_AFTER=$active_after"
  echo "USERBOT_ENABLED_BEFORE=$enabled_before"
  echo "USERBOT_ENABLED_AFTER=$enabled_after"
  echo "SOURCE_CHECKOUT_HEAD=$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD)"
  echo "LIVE_CHECK_ID=req_20261114165600000000a048"
} | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
test "$result" = PASS && test "$active_before" = active && test "$active_after" = active && test "$enabled_before" = "$enabled_after"
